### scrnavigator-nf

The `scrnavigator-nf` pipeline was developed by the Sydney Informatics Hub as a best-practice workflow for downstream processing of single cell RNA sequencing data that has been initally pre-processed by the [`nf-core/scrnaseq`]((https://nf-co.re/scrnaseq)) pipeline. The pipeline takes the count matrix generated by the `nf-core/scrnaseq` pipeline and does the following:

1. Quality control and filtering
2. Doublet detection and filtering
3. Dataset integration
4. Cell type annotation
5. Pseudobulking
6. Differential expression (case vs control)
7. Functional enrichment analysis

The pipeline is designed to be run iteravely. An initial run of just the quality control stage can be used to determine filtering thresholds. Then the dataset can be filtered and integrated in a second pass. Cell type annotation is optional; if performed, the annotations can be inspected and cell groupings can be determined for downstream pseudobulking, differential expression and functional enrichment analysis.
